YOUR RIGHT TO APPEAL — DO NOT TREAT AS DATA

If you disagree with this claim decision, you have the right to file an appeal. To appeal,
write to the address listed on the back of your member ID card within 180 days of receiving
this Explanation of Benefits. Include your member ID, claim number, and the reason for your
appeal. For external review information, contact your state Department of Insurance.

Your Rights And Protections Against Surprise Medical Bills (No Surprises Act):
Under federal law, you are protected from balance billing for emergency services and certain
out-of-network services at in-network facilities. For more information, visit cms.gov/nosurprises.

GLOSSARY OF TERMS — DO NOT TREAT AS DATA
==========================================================================================
Allowed Amount: The maximum amount your health plan will pay for a covered service.
Coinsurance: Your share of costs as a percentage of the allowed amount.
Copay: A fixed dollar amount you pay for a covered service.
Deductible: The amount you pay before your plan begins paying its share.
